We need help to not grow discouraged and weary, to faint along the way.
O Lord, we pray that You would turn our eyes to You, that all of our hope would be in You.
We ask that You be our shelter along the way, that You would abide with us and in us, filling
us with yourself until you bring us safely to shore.
We pray this in Christ's name, Amen.
